podcast.title: Decline in US Charts (Late 1956)
podcast.body: The initial wave of white rockabilly acts that achieved prominence between 1955 and 1956, including artists like Carl Perkins, Gene Vincent, and Bill Haley, experienced a significant decline by late 1956, failing to secure further major hits in the US. "The wave of white rock-a-billy acts that had hit throughout 1955 and 56 had all fizzled."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Origins at Sun Records
podcast.body: The birth of rock-a-billy is closely tied to Sun Records, where artists like Johnny Cash recorded music stylistically indistinguishable from other rock-a-billy acts. "this is effectively part two of a three-parter about Sun Records and the birth of rock-billy."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
